values: 耀光帝国的王子，使用精湛的剑术和附魔技巧来与敌人作战。
The Prince of the Lightbearer Empire who fights with masterful swordplay and enchantments.
In the name of the Lightbearer Empire.
I must ask you to leave.
荣光属于帝国，我只是履行了职责
Glory belongs to the Empire. I merely fulfilled my duty.
世人渴求完美的王子……我，即是那个标准的答案
The world desires a perfect prince, and so I will be.
无论何时，都要保持最佳仪态
Maintain the best composure at all times.
开始吧。角度、力道……嗯，还不能松懈
Let's begin. The angle, the force... hmm, still not perfect.
I'll have someone store it properly.
It's nice to let one's mind drift every once in a while.
方便的话，为我来杯红茶吧
If it isn't too much trouble, I'd like a cup of black tea.
宫廷礼仪老师找遍了皇宫也没找到逃课的佩吉公主，最后只好硬着头皮去问正在书房办公的奥利安。奥利安端起茶杯向老师保证没见到她，以此掩盖桌下佩吉的细微动静。

After Peggy skipped etiquette class, her tutor searched the whole palace before finally asking Orion in his study. Orion calmly raised his teacup and said he hadn't seen her, conveniently covering the faint rustles coming from under his desk.
老园丁曾回忆，在佩吉公主还要听睡前故事的年纪，他偶尔会看到年少的奥利安独自站在走廊下，隔着窗户注视着屋内王后为佩吉讲故事的身影。
An old gardener once recalled seeing young Orion alone in the corridor, back when Peggy still needed bedtime stories. He would stand outside the window and watch the queen read to her.
无论是在盛夏的行猎，还是在私人剑术练习，从未有人见过奥利安解开领口的衣扣。
Whether he is hunting under the summer sun or practicing swordplay in private, no one has ever seen Orion loosen even the top button of his collar.
在一次皇家演奏会上，奥利安殿下因听到了无法容忍的杂音而中途离场。事后人们发现，那只是第二小提琴手的琴弦松了一点点。
At a royal concert, Prince Orion walked out halfway through because of an unbearable noise. Later, everyone learned the second violinist's string had been just a little loose.
奥利安虽然年轻，但在朝堂辩论中从未败过，总能用最优雅的措辞让指出对手的逻辑漏洞，直到对方羞愧得无法言语。
Orion may be young, but he has never lost a debate at court. With a smile and perfect manners, he can expose every flaw in an argument until his opponent has nothing left to say.
迪尔格雷是唯一一个能不经通报直接面见奥利安的人。据说他们常在深夜一起下棋，但棋盘上往往一步未动。
Cyran is the only person allowed to see Orion without being announced. People say they often play chess late into the night, though the board usually looks suspiciously untouched.
传说中，奥利安驯鹰从不需要用传统的训练方法，它们似乎天生就愿意服从他的指令。
They say Orion doesn't train falcons the usual way. The birds simply seem to decide, from the start, that obeying him is the sensible choice.
只要是奥利安殿下组织的狩猎，贵族们总能满载而归。猎物出现的时机、路线仿佛都经过了精密的排练。
Whenever Prince Orion organizes a hunt, the nobles always return loaded with game. The animals appear at such perfect times and places that it almost feels rehearsed.
奥利安对生食十分厌恶，即便是最顶级的牛排，如果让他看到一丝血丝，也会被优雅地退回后厨。
Orion can't stand raw food. Even the finest steak will be sent back with perfect manners if he spots the faintest trace of blood.
奥利安的私人书房是禁地，他从不让侍从插手整理。并非因为藏着禁书，而是因为那些书页上密密麻麻写满了笔记。
Orion's private study is off-limits, and no attendant is allowed to tidy it. Not because he is hiding forbidden books, but because nearly every page is covered in his notes.
梅林阁下，您相信天命吗？
Magister Merlin, do you believe in destiny?
方便的话，为我来杯红茶吧
If it isn't too much trouble, I'd like a cup of black tea.
